questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
The university is quite different as you have to participate in class and the grades are dependent on this.
There were quite a lot of Palestine demonstrations while I was there, which the host university shot down with police who acted very violently, which really changed my view on UvA.
The professors at this university are super clever and good!
